name: data-display/timeline
title: Timeline
description: Events in order, with a progress line that follows scrolling.

files.content:
export { Timeline } from './Timeline';
export type { TimelineEvent, TimelineProps } from './Timeline';

keyboard.action: Move between events that have details.
Show or hide an event’s details.

notes: An ordered list, so its length and each event’s position are announced.
Times are `<time>` elements; detail toggles are buttons with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
The current event says “(now)” to screen readers as well as showing a magenta mark.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The line is drawn full and does not follow scrolling.
